Package uk.ac.keele.csc30067.legacy

Class HourlyEmployee

java.lang.Object
uk.ac.keele.csc30067.legacy.Employee
uk.ac.keele.csc30067.legacy.HourlyEmployee
public class HourlyEmployee extends Employee
A concrete implementation of the Employee class, for an employee who's paid by the hour. It will account for overtime, considering 40 hours per standard week.

    • earnings

      public double earnings()
      Calculate earnings for this type of Employee. This method overrides the abstract method earnings() in Employee, so it must provide an implementation (which is specific for the derived class). Note the use of the @Override annotation, which is optional but recommended. It tells the compiler that the method is supposed to override a method in the superclass (in this case, Employee).
      Specified by:
      earnings in class Employee
      Returns:
      the earnings of the employee
